title: Gunslicer Poses
tagline: The solo-pose system for the GS animation set.
description: The GS-side pose vocabulary split out of Delectatio et Dominium: 12 solo vibe poses (dance, stretch, meditate, show off, and more) executed by SkyrimNet_AnimationsGS over the Gunslicer animation set, plus StopPosing and CommandStopPose to end them, and the muse's pose-consideration prompt that lets nearby NPCs decide to strike a pose on their own. The SNGS_Pose category is registered at runtime by the SNAnimGS_UI DLL; the paired Babo-event poses stay in the Delectatio et Dominium pack.
author: regalrascal
